FULL.name: FULL

NO-REFINE.name: NO-REFINE
NO-REFINE.question: What does iterative refinement contribute beyond the first evaluated candidate?

NO-SURGICAL.name: NO-SURGICAL

NO-DETFIX.name: NO-DETFIX

SINGLE-SHOT.name: SINGLE-SHOT
